The [[human]] [[Force-sensitive]] [[Shin Hati]] owned a '''probe droid''' during the [[New Republic Era]]. While on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]], the [[probe droid]] was utilized by Hati to uncover the [[LothalNet comm tower E-272|location]] on the [[Mandalorian]] [[Sabine Wren]].<ref name="Part One" />
